name: The Three Little Pigs
trigger: Architectural debt retrospectives, stabilization sprints, or infrastructure reviews following high-traffic incidents.
canvas: 3 Zones: House of Straw, Sticks, Bricks
canvasLine: 3 Zones: House of Straw, Sticks, Bricks · 60–90 min

steps.text: Set the stage (10m): recite the Prime Directive; Straw was a compromise, not bad craft.
Gather data (20m): list systems under Straw, Sticks, Bricks with evidence.
Generate insights (25m): map the path from Straw to Sticks to Bricks.
Decide (20m): pick one Straw component; give its promotion a coverage gate.
Close (5m): name the Brick the next incident would rely on.

action: A Straw component becomes a P0 refactoring spike with a test-coverage gate before it carries production traffic.
provenance: Source names the canvas and the intent and leaves the phases' wording and minutes to the facilitator.

origin.note: A common retro metaphor; no documented originator.
